verdict.rationale: Polar documents a dedicated sandbox server, fully isolated from production, with unlimited test accounts and organizations and end-to-end checkout using Stripe test cards. It also publishes a separate sandbox MCP endpoint, so AI agents can work against sandbox rather than live data. This is true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run flag. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior and parity with production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: It's a dedicated server, completely isolated from the production instance where you can do all the experiments you want
To test Polar or work on your integration without worrying about actual money processing or breaking your live organization, you can use our sandbox environment.
The sandbox environment allows you to experience the complete customer funnel, including checkout. You can perform test payments using Stripe's test card numbers.
